name: Liontown Limited
summary: Liontown Limited engages in the exploration, evaluation, and development of mineral properties in Australia. It primarily explores for lithium, gold, and nickel deposits. The company's flagship property is the Kathleen Valley lithium project located in Perth, Western Australia. The company was formerly known as Liontown Resources Limited and change its name to Liontown Limited in November 2025. Liontown Limited was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in West Perth, Australia.
